title: Is it possible to use Mono as scripting backend?
body:
What is the reason why do we have to switch to IL2CPP backend?
What would it take to stay with Mono backend but use entityframework core with sqlite?
author: ClassyCircuit

comments.body: A good question. Unfortunately I don't remember the answer. Please try on your own. From what I remember it won't work in build or even in Unity Editor.
Going to close the issue. Feel free to reply if any new information.
